body.name: Published equal-square block comparator
body.construction: For \(n_B=n_S=n\), \(\Phi_n^{\mathrm{eq}}(R)=\max\{2nk:k\mid n,\ \binom{2n/k}{n/k}\ge R\}\), with value \(-\infty\) if the displayed set is empty; this is the best retention within the equal \(k\)-block family of Liu, Shaikh, and Toulis.
